steps.message:
1. What exactly is the current diff, i.e. which files and functions have been changed? In particular, have you touched the free block test, the sweep, the color checks, and the header interpretation in all the places where those things occur? Without the actual changes it is impossible to say where the new test has gone wrong.

2. What is the precise form of the crash and at what point in the bootstrap does it happen? A signal number, a backtrace and the command that produced it would be needed, as would some indication of whether the same thing can be made to occur from a small hand prepared example.

3. Have you yet tried to get along by shutting the compression path off and using the old form of the free list? If so, what was the last setting that still gave a working result, and what is the first setting at which the trouble appears?

4. For the first and last block of any run which gets into trouble, what are the values to be seen in the header, more especially in the size part, the color part and the part of the first word which is now used to hold a next pointer? It is from a comparison of those values that one may be able to tell what the two disagreeing tests are doing.

5. Are the first and last of the two in question kept in a state that agrees as to the count, and if not, just where in the order of the operations does that agreement get lost? The count would appear to be the thing on which the two must depend in order to be of use.

6. What does the log of the mark pass show for the first of the blocks in a run, and does that show that the new test has either passed over it or taken it to be something that it is not? The same would of course be wanted from the sweep as well.

7. Is the portion of the code that is to be seen on the present screen a part of what has been altered, or was it only being looked at in the course of getting about in the neighborhood of the change?

8. Have any of the tests of the basic suite been run since the latest alteration, and if they have, what is it that they have shown, both as to the tests that have gone through and those that have not?
